explication: This repository packages three complementary agent skills: deliberate learning exercises, optional post-commit prompting, and repository orientation. The main user flow is to invoke the learning skill after substantial coding work, then participate in an interactive exercise; the optional orient flow creates an orientation file that can seed lessons. The README also documents a team measurement playbook. No source excerpts were supplied, so relationships below are limited to those explicitly described in the README; the auto-hook implementation path is identified from the file tree, not inspected.
